$comment: Brand data for hyperai-tui. The build (scripts/build-patch.mjs) reads these values to produce the pnpm patch that rebrands the upstream @deepseek-harness-tui/dsh-tui package; the logo art is generated from brand/hyperai-logo.png by scripts/generate-logo-art.mjs.

logo.origin: GitHub organization avatar of https://github.com/hyperai (official HyperAI organization profile image)
logo.treatment: Downsampled to a 26x26 true-color half-block sprite; no redraw. The light-terminal variant maps the white plate to an ink tone for contrast; the official pink accents are unchanged.
